description: For CAD use the execution-arm offline library with current FoundationPose and default extra insertion 0 mm; TSDF GraspGen poses use the actual arm front TCP with zero additional insertion. For unknown objects feed the current published TSDF surface point cloud to GraspGen and request one native 100-candidate pool per round. The graph may request one additional round after confirmed exhaustion. Remain bound to the same qualified execution arm, target, capture and scene. GraspGen TCP +Z is prefiltered to the world +X forward / -Z downward sector with a configurable lateral angle limit, default 30 degrees. Grasp Lift follows world +Z for 150 mm. Numerical endpoint orientation and sampled Lift FK checks enforce these constraints before execution. 所有 GraspGen 抓取按执行臂当前指端 TCP 选择较近的平行夹爪半转等价姿态，随后进入 IK 和完整碰撞检查。CAD 离线抓姿按库中 A/B 归属读取。 GraspGen model contact TCP is aligned with the actual gripper_front_A/B, with distinct left/right orientation transforms and zero extra insertion. Check the declared Robotiq model and base-to-contact 195 mm conversion; actual mount-to-front offset is 185 mm. Old grasp_insertion_m settings are retired. Keep forward/downward +Z sector and all actual-gripper geometry/collision checks.
